name: zfmv_action_image_update
description: zFMV_ActionImage::Update blits the loaded image to the active target or software primary path, optionally adjusts surfaces, and always returns 0.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV image action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463320 validates the MSVC thiscall Update hook: compute one iteration for the software renderer path and two for non-software paths, return 0 immediately when image is null, use postprocess plus zVid_Image::BlitToActiveTarget plus primary unlock when forcePrimaryPostprocess is set or the active renderer path is 3dfx, otherwise dispatch through g_zVideo_pfnBltSwToPrimaryRect with source image, zero color-key mode, null source rect, and blitRect as destination, optionally call zVideo::AdjustSurfacesIfEnabled with waitForPresent and blitPrimaryToSwFirst set, then return 0.

The dependency frontier has no visible source blockers; RunPostprocessOnPrimaryBuffer, BlitToActiveTarget, Dispatch_UnlockPrimarySurfaceState, and AdjustSurfacesIfEnabled are accepted dependencies, and the software blit is the existing renderer dispatch pointer.
The native smoke patches the renderer dependencies and verifies null-image early return, the software blit plus adjust-surfaces path, and the 3dfx-style two-pass postprocess/blit/unlock path.
